subject: organic
question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：Weinreb ketone synthesis。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：PhMgBr, THF, 0 °C；H₃O⁺。
answer: A Grignard or organolithium reagent adds once to an N-methoxy-N-methylamide (Weinreb amide), giving a ketone with no over-addition.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：The tetrahedral adduct is held as a stable five-membered chelate and only collapses to the ketone on work-up, after the excess organometallic has been destroyed. LiAlH₄ or DIBAL-H give the aldehyde instead.
